title: Late Deliveries
policy: If an order has not arrived within 5 days after the expected delivery date, the customer is eligible for a refund of the shipping fee. If it is more than 10 days past the expected delivery date, the customer may choose a replacement shipment or a full refund, subject to a support agent confirming the order with the carrier. Orders more than 21 days late or with no tracking updates must be escalated to the Logistics team. Support agents cannot issue refunds directly; they prepare the request for approval.

title: Refunds and Returns
policy: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days after the returned item is received and inspected. Return shipping is free for wrong or faulty items; otherwise the customer pays return shipping. Requests made more than 30 days after delivery are outside policy and require a manager's decision.

title: Damaged Products
policy: Damage must be reported within 7 days of delivery with at least one clear photo of the item and packaging. If the report is valid, the customer may choose a free replacement or a full refund, and no return of the damaged item is required for items under 50 USD. Reports made after 7 days require a manager's review.

title: Missing Items
policy: Missing items must be reported within 7 days of delivery. Support verifies the packing list against the order. If the item was part of the order, the missing item is re-shipped free of charge or the item price is refunded, at the customer's choice. If the packing list cannot be verified, escalate to the Warehouse team.

title: Cancellations
policy: Orders can be cancelled free of charge while the status is Pending Payment or Processing. Once an order is Shipped or In Transit it cannot be cancelled; the customer must wait for delivery and use the return policy. Cancelled paid orders are refunded to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

title: Payment Problems
policy: For double charges, failed payments that still debited the card, or unauthorized charges, support must not promise a refund. These cases are escalated to the Billing team, who verify the transaction within 3 business days. Customers should never be asked to send full card numbers; only the last four digits and the transaction date are needed.
